notablePrerequisites:
Argothian Elder does not have summoning sickness.
Your devotion to green is at least four.
description:
Activate Nykthos by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping Nykthos and Wirewood Lodge.
Activate Wirewood Lodge by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Argothian Elder.
Repeat.
